Container.Name: traefik
Container.Overview:
The world’s most popular cloud-native application proxy that helps developers and operations teams build, deploy and run modern microservices applications quickly and easily.
For a guide on how to install this reverse proxy, head over to our documentation website.
https://docs.ibracorp.io
Come join in on the community fun and get support by joining our discord!
https://discord.gg/VWAG7rZ
Container.Requires: No default labels: dashboard is LAN-only by port 8183 until the user explicitly exposes it via the config file.

Config.Name: HTTP Entrypoint
Config.Description: HTTP entrypoint: external traffic (or Cloudflare Tunnel) hits this host port

Config.Name: HTTPS Entrypoint
Config.Description: HTTPS entrypoint (optional): only needed if Traefik terminates TLS directly

Config.Name: Dashboard: LAN/VPN Entrypoint
Config.Description: Dashboard: LAN/VPN access to Traefik UI

Config.Name: Traefik Appdata
Config.Description: Static + dynamic config files live here: /mnt/user/appdata/traefik

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker provider: allows labels-based routing for other containers

Config.Name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional: only needed if using Cloudflare DNS for Let's Encrypt
